value.reported_conduct: alleged illicit generation of foreign revenue for the DPRK

sources.quote: Democratic People’s Republic of Korea nationals Kim Ki Hyok, Jon Yon Gun and Kim Song Il, representatives of Chinyong IT in the Russian Federation, the Lao People’s Democratic Republic and China, respectively, are said to have engaged in the illicit generation of foreign revenue for the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea.

notes: Collective, source-attributed allegation, not an adjudicated individual finding. China replied that it did not find illegal cyber-financial activities by the relevant individuals, and the report states investigations continued. Organization-level transaction totals, bank accounts, and money-transfer details were not assigned to Kim individually.

identity_boundary: Kim Song Il (김성일) is the Jinyong/Chinyong representative in China identified by the May 2023 Republic of Korea joint designation release and independently named in UN S/2023/656. Same-name people or accounts remain separate pending a source-explicit bridge; collective labor-control or foreign-revenue allegations remain at the reported claim stage.
